messages:
miguel_sales: Hey @finance team — need a quick approval for a one-time concession to keep ChannelCo (reseller) from churning. They hit a usage spike and exceeded their committed tier for Feb. Invoice INV-2026-345 shows a $8,400 delta. Proposed solution: apply a one-time credit of $6,000 and bump them to the next tier for 90 days (waive overage rates). This is a strategic partner; sales is asking we do this to preserve the channel. :disappointed_relieved:
sarah_finance: Can you paste the math and the commit terms? need to see ARR impact and that this is strictly one-off (no precedent). also attach the invoice PDF.
miguel_sales: Math: expected commit $50k/mo, actual usage $58.4k for Feb => overage $8.4k. ChannelCo argues the spike was due to onboarding new customers from their end and they signed up for a pilot we did not fully account for in their commit. Invoice INV-2026-345 uploaded (billing-bot).
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-345 uploaded to /invoices/INV-2026-345.pdf (uploader: miguel_sales)
anya_revops: tagging in revops — if we do a credit + tier bump we need a short addendum (3 months) and a note in RevOps to prevent automatic collection. I can draft the amendment. Question: is the credit split (revenue recognition) okay from finance POV?
sarah_finance: $6k credit would reduce recognized revenue this month by $6k (cash still collectible for the remaining $2.4k unless we credit it). need COGS impact negligible. Approve in principle if sales owns a note documenting business reason and we add the 3-month trial clause. Also want one sentence in the addendum: 'This concession is a one-time, non-precedential remedy.'
tom_legal: please include that exact wording and specify no amendment to the MSA other than a two-paragraph addendum. i'll draft a short clause and run a quick legal review. we should avoid changing payment terms/net days.
miguel_sales: agreed — we'll keep net terms unchanged. i'll have ChannelCo sign the addendum and ack that this is one-off.
anya_revops: i'll prepare the addendum template and a RevOps ticket to block automated dunning during the credit. assigning to @sarah_finance for the final sign-off on the credit amount.
sarah_finance: okay — approve $6,000 one-time credit contingent on: 1) signed addendum with the non-precedential clause, 2) RevOps ticket created to pause collection for the credited amount, 3) note in the account record explaining the business rationale. once those three are complete i'll mark the credit in the ledger. :+1:
miguel_sales: thanks team — i'll get ChannelCo to sign and loop back here with the signed PDF and account note by EOD tomorrow. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
